about.title: About Me
about.paragraph: I am Muhammad Riszki Fadhillah — a full-stack developer based in Jakarta, studying at University of Darma Persada. I build web applications and REST APIs with JavaScript, TypeScript, PHP, and Python: from Laravel dashboards to Express and Node.js services backed by MySQL or MongoDB. I like turning real problems, like small-business (UMKM) platforms, into working products end to end. Currently open to work — onsite in Jakarta or remote.

whatIDo.title: WEB DEVELOPMENT
whatIDo.subtitle: Full-Stack Web Applications
whatIDo.description: I build complete web apps — from Laravel and React front ends to the database behind them — for small businesses, dashboards, and internal tools.

whatIDo.title: API & DATA
whatIDo.subtitle: Backend Services that Hold Up
whatIDo.description: The part users never see: REST endpoints, authentication, data models, validation, and tests — built on Node.js, PHP, or Python depending on the job.

career.description: Building a UMKM (small business) platform with Laravel and Blade — store profiles, product catalogs, and dashboards for local sellers.
Designed and shipped a job marketplace REST API on Node.js and Express: authentication, job and application endpoints, request validation, and automated tests.
Flutter mobile app project and an AI-based security project in Python, alongside core computer science coursework.
